source_version: Theory of Computing15(2019),Article13; final publisher source November1,2019
title: Low-degree factors of shallow arithmetic circuits retain controlled depth and size

standard_prerequisites.name: Formal power series, Hensel lifting and arithmetic circuit depth reduction
standard_prerequisites.statement: Original cited standard statements and all local root/factor reconstruction and supporting claims retained.
standard_prerequisites.use: Selected exact characteristic-zero theorem, no collector characteristic strengthening or recursive reproof of background results.

core_obligations: The authors express a low-degree algebraic root as a controlled polynomial in coefficient derivatives via Hensel lifting, use depth reduction without accumulating degree-dependent depth, and pass to irreducible factors through properly separating shifts and symmetric combinations of approximate roots. The complete local constructions and auxiliary-claim proofs are retained; the original constant-depth versus degree-size tradeoff is one target.

General VP factor closure is cited background; VNP/formula/branching-program applications and the root-only intermediate theorem are not extra counted targets.
